cases.name: abort-timeout-timed-out
cases.description: abort({ timeout }) reports a timeout when active work does not finish in time

cases.name: abort-timeout-completes
cases.description: abort({ timeout }) reports no timeout when work completes during the grace period

cases.name: abort-immediate-with-active-work
cases.description: abort() returns immediately when no timeout is supplied even if work is active

cases.name: abort-zero-timeout-with-active-work
cases.description: abort({ timeout: 0 }) returns immediately even if work is active

cases.name: abort-start-hook-throws
cases.description: abort() surfaces a throwing onAbortStart hook after cleanup has been committed

cases.name: abort-after-abort-is-idempotent
cases.description: abort() returns the empty aborted result when called after the throttle is already aborted

cases.name: abort-on-complete-skips-grace-period
cases.description: abort() skips the grace period when no work is active

cases.name: abort-cancels-active-and-queued
cases.description: abort() resolves active and queued execute promises without running abandoned queued work

cases.name: abort-during-draining-cancels-active-and-queued
cases.description: abort() cancels active and queued work while an existing drain is waiting

cases.name: on-acquire-throws
cases.description: a throwing onAcquire hook rejects execute() and releases the slot

cases.name: on-release-throws
cases.description: a throwing onRelease hook does not corrupt the completed throttle state

cases.name: on-contended-throws
cases.description: a throwing onContended hook rejects the contended caller without enqueueing it

cases.name: on-acquire-wait-throws
cases.description: a throwing onAcquireWait hook removes the queued caller and rejects it

cases.name: on-reject-throws
cases.description: a throwing onReject hook rejects execute() with the hook error and releases the slot

cases.name: drain-waits-for-active-and-queued
cases.description: drain() waits for active and queued work to complete before resolving

cases.name: drain-on-complete-returns-immediately
cases.description: drain() resolves immediately when the throttle is already complete

cases.name: drain-reuses-completion-promise
cases.description: multiple drain() callers wait on the same active completion path

cases.name: queued-operation-completes-after-release
cases.description: queued execute() calls start after the leading slot is released

cases.name: on-window-slide-throws
cases.description: a failing onWindowSlide hook rejects the queued operation

cases.name: execute-after-abort-throws
cases.description: execute() rejects after the throttle is aborted

cases.name: execute-during-draining-throws
cases.description: execute() rejects while the throttle is draining

cases.name: on-release-fires-exactly-once-still-busy
cases.description: onRelease fires exactly once per completed operation when the throttle remains busy afterward (no queue to hand off to)

cases.name: on-release-fires-exactly-once-became-idle
cases.description: onRelease fires exactly once when the last active operation completes and the throttle becomes idle

cases.name: on-release-fires-exactly-once-handoff-granted
cases.description: onRelease fires exactly once per operation when a release hands the slot off to a queued waiter

cases.name: on-release-fires-exactly-once-on-rejection
cases.description: onRelease fires exactly once when an operation completes via rejection rather than success

cases.name: on-release-fires-exactly-once-on-acquire-rollback
cases.description: onRelease fires exactly once when a throwing onAcquire hook rolls the slot back
